```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

// Route for API resources
Route::resource('notes', 'NotesController');
Route::resource('tags', 'TagsController');
Route::resource('relations', 'RelationsController');
```

This code snippet sets up routes for the `Note`, `Tag`, and `Relation` models using Laravel's routing system. The `apiResource` function generates the necessary routes, such as GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and index routes for each model.
